entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-05-05
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Follow up on behavior difference in `NullableAnalysis_24_State_From_NotType_Test_Class` and `NullableAnalysis_27_State_From_NotValue_Test_Class` unit-tests in `UnionsTests.cs` #83568
  • Ref safety diagnostics downgraded to warnings even in some safe contexts #83564
    18.7
  • Bug: Primary Constructors break “Go To Definition” for member access on constructor parameters (especially when consumed via NuGet with embedded sources) #83562

Closed

  • CS1929 is reported instead of CS1503 when extension methods share the same name. #83567
  • WithAnalyzers Compilation extensions throw on empty analyzers array #80395
    18.3

PullRequests

Created

  • Suppress snippets and tag helper completions in end-tag contexts #83573
    Area-IDE, Area-Razor
  • Avoid _ collision in bind-*:after property accessor #83572
    Area-Infrastructure, Area-Razor
  • Support primary constructors in RS0033/RS0034 code fixes #83571
  • Fix flaky AssemblyLoading_MultipleVersions_AnalyzerDependency test #83570
  • Fix formatting of multiline expressions in attributes #83566
    Area-IDE, Area-Razor
  • Fix leaked event handlers in AbstractRefreshQueue and ProjectSystemProject #83561
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode

Merged

  • Flesh out handling of `isExplicitNotNullTest` for union matching #83556
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions
  • Fix Razor directive attribute completion issues #83559
    Area-IDE, Area-Razor, Next
  • Add Razor assembly versions to DependentAssemblyVersions.csv #83558
    Area-Infrastructure, Area-Razor, Next
  • Allow creating compilation with empty analyzer list #83418
    Area-Compilers, Community, Next
  • Purge cache in roslyn CI #83480
    Area-Infrastructure, Feature - Caching Compiler, Next
  • Set source map for VSCode debugger #83550
    Area-Infrastructure, Feature - Caching Compiler

Updated

  • Make Razor a built in feature of the Roslyn language server #83575
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode
  • Add support for writing HTML literals using UTF-8 strings #83457
    Area-Infrastructure, Area-Razor
  • Fix ArgumentOutOfRangeException when orphan end tag follows HTML text #83574
    Area-Compilers, Area-Razor
  • Remove design-time code generation from the Razor compiler #83510
    Area-Infrastructure, Area-Razor
  • Extension indexers: fix receiver handling for implicit indexers in compound assignment #83553
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Indexers
  • Migrate servicehub crossgen and TFM to net10 #83557
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 327: Build ID 2967914 #83468
    Area-IDE
  • Closed class: Reduce amount of PE base type symbols created when looking for subtypes #83517
    Area-Compilers
  • Closed class: Do not suggest invalid types in inexhaustive switches #83493
    Area-Compilers
  • Unsafe evolution: avoid interior effect of `unsafe` modifier on members #83452
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Fix trivial spelling mistake #81595
    Area-IDE, Community
  • Support smart break line for `fixed` statement #83543
    Area-IDE, Community
  • Allow downloading compiler cache from CI to speed up local builds #83167
    Area-Infrastructure, Feature - Caching Compiler
  • Avoid evaluating platform-dependent shifts at compile time #83034
    Area-Compilers
  • Validate pooled objects in compiler tests #82784
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #83475
    Area-Infrastructure
  • fix: Add check before show signature help #80945
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
